summary: Neither party delivered the End Date extension notice required by 11:59 p.m. Eastern on 17 December 2018. The company terminated the merger agreement on 18 December 2018 and demanded the US$126.5 million reverse termination fee. The buyer sued to enforce the agreement; on 14 March 2019 the Delaware Court of Chancery ruled the termination valid; on 22 April 2019 the parties announced a US$92.5 million settlement. The merger was never consummated.
